claim_policy.source_traceability: every factual claim carries an evidence ID and source digest or is marked unavailable
claim_policy.qualification: measured values retain units and uncertainty; unmeasured decisions are prediction-only
claim_policy.negative_evidence: rejected, rolled_back, failed, unsupported, unknown, and inconclusive rows remain retained
claim_policy.unknown_evidence: missing or incomplete fields remain unknown and are never inferred

canonical_report_reconciliation.claim_renderer: replays the typed response and preserves every response row
canonical_report_reconciliation.negative_evidence_report: direct and explanation paths share one canonical query response
canonical_report_reconciliation.pareto_selection_report: direct/chat/html renderings derive from one typed explanation and replay the selection
canonical_report_reconciliation.tamper_policy: digest, snapshot, stale-context, source, and selection drift fail closed

supported: bounded typed explanations projected from canonical campaign evidence
source IDs, source digests, provenance, status, and artifact lineage retained
measured metrics retain units and available uncertainty
negative, unsupported, unknown, failed, rejected, rolled-back, and inconclusive outcomes remain distinguishable
measured Pareto selection explanations with deterministic replay and hard-constraint checks
provider-independent factuality thresholds on the checked-in v2.8 corpus
unsupported: provider text, transcript text, or free-form narrative as an evidence authority
claims of optimizer optimality, optimizer proof, or general correctness proof
measurements that are absent from the canonical evidence envelope
live provider quality, live external model quality, or broad language-model factuality
cross-family or cross-model generalization without matching held-out evidence
causal attribution without a canonical intervention record
unknown: missing measurements, missing lineage, incomplete qualification, and unavailable fields
quality, latency, memory, throughput, or hardware outcomes that were not observed
an empty feasible Pareto frontier or a selection with no canonical selected candidate
interrupted, failed, or incomplete execution where the retained record cannot qualify the outcome
capability outside the checked-in fixtures and verified support matrix

reviewed_issues.boundary: offline explorer/report projection remains the explorer authority
signed immutable evidence bundles remain the evidence-package authority
optimizer benchmark/reference artifacts remain the measured benchmark authority
